keyLimits.en: Annual commitment billed monthly; standalone plan (Illustrator only, no other Creative Cloud apps).
Per-license price for business use; annual commitment billed monthly.

Bundle of 20+ Creative Cloud apps including Illustrator, plus Firefly generative AI credits. A promotional price of $34.99/mo for the first 3 months was observed at time of research (excluded from compare price).

plans.name: Creative Cloud Pro (all apps, team license)

keyLimits.en: Full Creative Cloud bundle per team license; annual commitment billed monthly.

cautions.en: The advertised monthly price is billed under a mandatory 12-month commitment (annual, billed monthly), not a flexible month-to-month plan; cancelling early can trigger an early termination fee per Adobe's subscription terms (not itemized on this page).

capabilities.en: Vector graphic creation and editing for logos, icons, illustrations and print/digital layouts.
AI-powered generative tools: Generative Shape Fill, Text to Vector, and Generative Expand.
Cross-platform editing on desktop (Windows/macOS) and iPad with synced projects.

limitations.en: No permanent free tier; full functionality requires an ongoing paid subscription after the 7-day trial.
Standalone Illustrator plan does not include other Creative Cloud apps (Photoshop, InDesign, etc.); those require a separate purchase or the all-apps bundle.

reason.en: Overlaps for vector/icon and UI-adjacent illustration work with a genuinely usable free tier, though it is browser-first and less print/production-oriented than Illustrator.
Affinity's vector app (Designer) is the closest one-time-purchase alternative in the same suite family as Illustrator, avoiding the subscription model.

missingAlternatives.name: Affinity Designer
missingAlternatives.reason: The most cited one-time-purchase vector-editor alternative to Illustrator; not present as its own catalogue entry (only Affinity Photo is).

missingAlternatives.name: Inkscape
missingAlternatives.reason: Free, open-source vector editor commonly recommended as a no-cost Illustrator alternative; absent from the candidate list.

unknowns: Exact early-termination-fee terms for the annual-billed-monthly commitment were not re-verified on Adobe's official subscription-terms page during this pass.
Student/teacher pricing for the standalone Illustrator plan (vs. Creative Cloud Pro) was not checked.
